title: Detecting Threonine Deaminase Activity in Fission Yeast Cell Lysates
author: Sasaki, Nishimura, et al.

steps.title: Prepare stock solutions
steps.instruction: Make 100× salt, 1,000× vitamin, and 10,000× mineral stock solutions, filter‑sterilize, aliquot and store as described.

substeps.instruction: Salt stock (100×, 1 L): dissolve 106.6 g MgCl₂·6H₂O (520 mM), 1.47 g CaCl₂·2H₂O (10.0 mM), 100 g KCl (1.34 M), and 4 g Na₂SO₄ (28.2 mM) in RO water, bring to 1 L, filter through a 0.22 µm filter, split into 50 mL aliquots and store at ‑20 °C (or at 4 °C after thawing).

Vitamin stock (1,000×, 100 mL): dissolve 100 mg calcium pantothenate (4.20 mM), 1 000 mg nicotinic acid (81.2 mM), 1 000 mg myo‑inositol (55.5 mM) and 1 mg biotin (40.8 mM) in RO water, bring to 100 mL, filter (0.22 µm), split into 15 mL aliquots and store at ‑20 °C (or 4 °C after thaw).

Mineral stock (10,000×, 100 mL): dissolve 500 mg H₃BO₃ (0.9 mM), 530 mg MnSO₄·4H₂O (23.7 mM), 400 mg ZnSO₄·7H₂O (13.9 mM), 200 mg FeCl₃·6H₂O (7.40 mM), 1 000 mg (NH₄)₆Mo₇O₂₄·4H₂O (8.1 mM), 100 mg KI (6.02 mM), 40 mg CuSO₄·5H₂O (1.60 mM) and 1 000 mg citric acid (47.6 mM) in RO water, bring to 100 mL, filter (0.22 µm), split into 15 mL aliquots and store at ‑20 °C (or 4 °C after thaw).

steps.title: Prepare 40 % glucose solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 40 g glucose in RO water, bring volume to 100 mL, autoclave at 121 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Prepare EMM2 base (no glucose, no salts)
steps.instruction: Combine potassium hydrogen phthalate, Na₂HPO₄·12H₂O, NH₄Cl and RO water to 1 L, autoclave at 121 °C for 20 min.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 g potassium hydrogen phthalate (14.7 mM) and 5.55 g Na₂HPO₄·12H₂O (15.5 mM) to RO water.
Adjust volume to 1 L with RO water, then autoclave 121 °C, 20 min.

steps.title: Assemble complete EMM2 medium
steps.instruction: Add autoclaved glucose solution and filter‑sterilized stock solutions to the autoclaved EMM2 base to obtain final concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 mL of the autoclaved 40 % glucose solution (gives 2 % w/v glucose).
Add 10 mL of the 100× salt stock (filter‑sterilized).
Add 1 mL of the 1,000× vitamin stock.
Add 0.1 mL of the 10,000× mineral stock.
Mix gently; store at 20–25 °C for several months.
Optional: replace NH₄Cl with an equivalent amount of amino acids as nitrogen source (see footnote #).

steps.title: Prepare solid YES medium
steps.instruction: Combine all YES components in RO water, autoclave, then pour plates.

substeps.instruction: In a 1 L flask add 5 g yeast extract (0.5 % w/v), 20 g glucose (2 % w/v), 225 mg adenine hemisulfate salt (1.2 mM), 225 mg uracil (2.0 mM), 225 mg l‑leucine (1.7 mM), 225 mg l‑histidine (1.4 mM), 225 mg l‑lysine monohydrochloride (1.2 mM), and 20 g agar powder (2 % w/v).
Add RO water to a final volume of 1 L.

steps.title: Cool and pour YES plates
steps.instruction: Cool autoclaved YES medium to ≤60 °C, pour into Petri dishes, and store.

substeps.instruction: Allow the medium to cool at 20–25 °C until temperature reaches ~60 °C.
Pour into 30–40 Petri dishes (≈20 mL per plate).
Wrap plates in plastic wrap and store at 20–25 °C for several months.
